name: Inner Palace ~Shiroki Koukyuu~
original_name: インナーパレス～白き後宮～
source:
Stagnating kingdom of Punea is succeeded by emperor Tokina. New emperor has many wives who gave birth to six sons. Main character is the sixth son Leon. He's the last in the line of succession, so needs to execute enormous efforts to ever wear the crown.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
